purpose: compare the five candidate window models for the valuation_attractiveness v2 migration on fixed evaluation axes; option scores are method attributes, NOT derived from PetroChina's actual percentile values
governance_note: No option is accepted or rejected because of today's percentile numbers. The actual midrank percentiles are reported in the R4F north-star doc for evidence only and are not part of the option-choice rationale. R4F does not compute 'what would option A score' / 'what would option B score' and then pick the more convenient one.

axis_descriptions.north_star_alignment: low PE at a possible cycle peak must not automatically score high
axis_descriptions.uses_trusted_R4E5_evidence: consumes the CI-confirmed R4E.5 dual-window trusted percentile profile
axis_descriptions.avoids_double_counting: does not weight one economic valuation signal twice
axis_descriptions.preserves_component_topology: keeps va_pe/va_pb/va_ps as exactly three valuation components
axis_descriptions.adds_free_parameters: number of new tunable parameters introduced (fewer is better)
axis_descriptions.cycle_safety: behavior is safe before the PE cycle-context contract is formalized
axis_descriptions.explainability: an observer can state why a component got its evidence bundle
axis_descriptions.determinism: identical fixed inputs reproduce identical component evidence
axis_descriptions.migration_complexity: work to move the current shadow to this model
axis_descriptions.production_false_precision_risk: risk of presenting a non-production estimate as a precise production value

options.name: THREE_YEAR_ONLY
options.rationale: Closest to the old engine, but it discards the trusted 5y evidence and contradicts the dual-window policy intent. It keeps the numeric lower_better transform with no cycle gate.

options.name: FIVE_YEAR_ONLY
options.rationale: Longer look-back, but arbitrarily drops 3y; the North Star asks to observe both 3y and 5y. Keeps the numeric lower_better transform with no cycle gate.

options.name: SIX_SEPARATE_COMPONENTS

axes.avoids_double_counting: NO (same metric scored twice per window)

options.rationale: 3y and 5y are overlapping windows of the same valuation signal; splitting them into six components double-counts the same economic signal and breaks the three-component topology.

options.name: DUAL_WINDOW_SINGLE_COMPONENT

axes.north_star_alignment: YES (PE numeric contribution gated pending cycle context)
axes.uses_trusted_R4E5_evidence: YES (binds both 3y and 5y on every component)
axes.avoids_double_counting: YES (one component per metric, one aggregated value)
axes.cycle_safety: FAIL_CLOSED (PE numeric scoring NOT AUTHORIZED until cycle-context contract)
axes.explainability: HIGH (each component binds a dual-window evidence bundle)
axes.migration_complexity: MEDIUM (registry v2 / policy v2 / shadow refresh)

options.rationale: Keeps the three-component topology; each component binds both percentile_3y and percentile_5y as one dual-window evidence bundle with fixed 0.5/0.5 Decimal weights. No window is dropped, no economic signal is weighted twice, no free parameter is added, and the PE numeric contribution is fail-closed until the cycle-context contract exists.

options.name: EVIDENCE_CARD_ONLY_NO_SHADOW_REFRESH

axes.production_false_precision_risk: HIGH (keeps presenting old 3y-only shadow as current)

options.rationale: The North Star already authorizes independent dimension scoring and a non-production shadow exists; refusing migration entirely is too conservative. Production stays blocked regardless of this option.

selected_option.name: DUAL_WINDOW_SINGLE_COMPONENT
selected_option.note: selection rationale is method attributes only; no actual percentile value was used to accept or reject any option
